explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant with multiple OAI inspections and Warning Letters before and after the shortage posting

sentences.text: Our sterile water supply comes from Nephron SC, LLC (FEI 3010892830) as shown on the product label.
FDA inspected this plant in 2011 and classified it OAI, with the classification known by 2011-09-15.
A 2014 inspection was also classified OAI with 18 Form 483 observations, known by 2014-05-22.
Another OAI inspection occurred in 2015, known by 2015-11-12.
FDA issued a Warning Letter on 2013-09-24 and another on 2016-09-02 for this facility.
The shortage was first posted by FDA on 2021-11-23.
A 2019 inspection ended 2019-11-15 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2022-04-13 — 739 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued 2020-09-22 — 427 days before the shortage posting.
An inspection ending 2022-04-20 was classified OAI with 6 observations citing validation lacking for sterile drug products — 148 days after the shortage posting.
Warning Letters followed on 2022-10-11 and 2022-10-21 — 322 and 332 days after the shortage posting.
Class II recalls for sterile water from this firm started 2023-01-12 and 2023-02-23 — 415 and 457 days after the shortage posting.
A 2023-02-10 inspection was classified OAI with 15 observations citing SOPs not followed and validation lacking — 444 days after the shortage posting.
Subsequent inspections in 2024-02-09 and 2024-09-25 were also classified OAI.
The most recent inspection ended 2025-08-22 and was classified VAI.
As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 59 months.
Corvale East has 3 days on hand and Corvale General has 8 days on hand at current usage.
The approved therapeutic interchange is WATER 1 mL/mL from Hospira, Inc. (NDC 00409488710), same product alternate manufacturer, approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-05-18.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-f5d528.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%sterile%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%sterile%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-94c73c.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('bc04a883-babc-87a6-e053-2995a90a3dfd') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-69a387.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%sterile%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-191407.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%sterile%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-fbba9a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%sterile%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-df993b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3010892830', '3001677091') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-0dfc8d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3010892830', '3001677091') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-ba27d1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3010892830') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('nephron sc')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-bb77a5.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('nephron sc', 'nephron') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%sterile%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-0bc468.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('731152', '868313', '938418', '1167490', '1168119', '1197994', '1229051', '1247772') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-905088.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00487610501')
